name: Depot-country witnesses (miller, hamlet woman, ostlers, clerks, keepers, brown-coat men)
aliases: the two men in good brown coats

physicalDetails.detail: Miller: flour in his eyebrows, slate on the wall, still put out by it. Hamlet woman: notched stick on a nail. Toll-keeper: thin, brown, leather apron, a day-book, fine beans. Bridge-keeper: up lighting his pipe, speaks round the stem. Brown-coat men: two, good coats, older and younger, complain of horses. Plough's ostler: comes out in his shirt with a lantern, asks nothing.

voiceMarkers.detail: Miller: 'Thirty years I've milled here, and never once a carter buying back.' Woman: 'Cheap, he called it.' Toll-keeper: 'Grain don't come this way now. I'd know. Grain pays.' Bridge-keeper: 'He pays to the farthing, that one. And she was crying.' Brown-coat men: 'The prince's, my lady. Prince Arthas. He has them up at Strahnbrad.'

decisionsThisChapter.detail: Miller: the young cart man returned for the last four sacks of his own load and paid full rate, more than he'd sold them for, 'the damp had got into them'. Woman: half her house-notches have fresh marks since midsummer for the cheap flour. Wick ostler: a free carter left south before light, 'He always paid.' Second-depot clerk: short-rate loads are booked in from the big river depot; 'everything on this side of the river goes over the overseer's scale.' Brown-coat men and innkeeper: army has taken all remounts and oats; Arthas at Strahnbrad vs orcs from the camps burning farms in the hills; soldiers on every road that way; river depot by noon at first light; the Plough is the halfway inn. Toll-keeper: no grain on the Brill road for over a month; a company of King's foot cut across for the hill road a week ago and do not pay. Bridge-keeper: the overseer and wife went south at a trot yesterday after the bells for morning, no toll, she crying, sister on the south road.

knowledge.detail: Each holds one day-old fragment about the cart man, the short-rate flour, the river depot's role, the army or the overseer's flight.
